name: hud_ui_message_box_dialog_scalar_deleting_destructor
description: HudUiMessageBoxDialog::ScalarDeletingDestructor delegates to the message-box destructor and conditionally frees the object for deleting-destructor calls.
known_limits: No VC COFF byte target covers 0x4bf540 yet; current evidence is functional only.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja decompilation at 0x4bf540 validates the destructor call, flags bit 0 conditional operator delete, and return of self.

The native scalar-deleting destructor smoke constructs the fallback dialog, invokes ScalarDeletingDestructor with delete flag clear, verifies the returned self pointer, and checks the same teardown state covered by the direct destructor smoke.
